title: Bitcoin’s Biggest Problems Start Where Most Crypto Research Stops
description:
I take Bitcoin through the same 10-question review framework I use for every blockchain and ask the hard questions most investors avoid. In this video, I look at Bitcoin’s technical limitations, dependence on off-chain infrastructure, quantum computing risk, institutional narrative support, and whether it still offers strong upside from here. I also explain why I see Bitcoin as strongest as a narrative asset rather than a technology platform, why I think ICP is the best long-term scaling path, and why my long-term fair value estimate for Bitcoin is far lower than most people expect.
